title: Cooking at home
description: Follow a recipe and cook something simple.

explanation.summary: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a list of steps, and the steps are written as orders to the person who will cook. In Spanish that is the imperative, so a recipe gives you a set of useful verbs in a new shape at the same time.

sections.heading: The recipe speaks to you
sections.body: Every step begins with a verb in the imperative, the form used to tell somebody to do something. With tú you add -e to an -ar verb and you drop the -r and add -e for an -er or -ir verb: mezcla la harina, ralla el queso, hierve el agua. It looks like the present tense, but the meaning is an order, which is why a recipe reads as a list of short sentences and not as a story.

examples.es: Mezcla la harina con la sal.
examples.en: Mix the flour with the salt.

examples.es: Ralla el queso sobre la sopa.
examples.en: Grate the cheese over the soup.

sections.heading: What goes into the dish
sections.body: The ingredients come first, with a quantity in front of each one: dos huevos, un poco de sal, medio litro de leche. The word for the ingredient is el ingrediente, and the word for the whole dish is la receta. When a recipe is too big for one person, you say que es para cuatro personas, and the quantity for each person is la ración.

examples.es: La receta de paella es para cuatro personas.
examples.en: The paella recipe is for four people.

examples.es: Necesito un ingrediente más: el colador.
examples.en: I need one more ingredient: the colander.

sections.heading: Order and quantity
sections.body: The order of the steps matters, so read the whole recipe before you start. Some steps are about quantity: un poco, un puñado, lo justo. Some are about time: durante diez minutos, hasta que hierva. And the last step is often the serving: sirve la sopa en un plato hondo.

examples.es: Remueve hasta que la mezcla esté lista.
examples.en: Stir until the mixture is ready.

examples.es: Deja la masa en un lugar frío durante dos horas.
examples.en: Leave the dough in a cold place for two hours.

exercises.prompt: Pair each word with its translation.
exercises.note: A recipe speaks to you directly: mezcla, ralla, hierve, añade.

exercises.prompt: Pick the Spanish word for “the recipe”.
exercises.note: Feminine: la receta. It also means what the doctor writes for you.
Masculine: el ingrediente. One of the things you put in the dish.
